title: Division Facts
subtitle: Divisors to 5, up to 15
bounds: PROTOCOL 4c, multiplication facts read backwards: p ÷ a = b with divisor a and quotient b both in the tier's band, p = a × b. T1 a,b 1-5; T2 max(a,b) 6-8, both 2-8; T3 max 9-10, both 2-10; T4 max 11-12, both 2-12; T5 max 13-15, both 2-15. Wrong choices: distinct non-negative integers up to 999.

tiers.name: Up to 25 ÷ 5
tiers.description: Divide by 1 to 5: the times-table facts read backwards.

tiers.name: Up to 64 ÷ 8
tiers.description: Divide by 2 to 8. Think: what times the divisor makes it?

tiers.name: Up to 100 ÷ 10
tiers.description: Divide by 2 to 10. Use the fact family.

tiers.name: Up to 144 ÷ 12
tiers.description: Divide by 2 to 12. Split into tens and the rest.

tiers.name: Up to 225 ÷ 15
tiers.description: Divide by 2 to 15. Multiply back to check.

GROUP_OFF.student: Close: a group or two off. Multiply your answer by the divisor to check.
GROUP_OFF.teacher: Quotient off by one or two: counted a group or two too many or too few.

SUBTRACTED.student: Divide, don't subtract. 20 ÷ 5 asks how many 5s fit in 20.
SUBTRACTED.teacher: Subtracts the divisor from the dividend (p − a) instead of dividing.

MULTIPLIED.student: Divide, don't multiply. 20 ÷ 5 asks how many 5s fit in 20.
MULTIPLIED.teacher: Multiplies dividend and divisor (p × a) instead of dividing.

TENS_SLIP.student: Right ones digit, wrong tens. Multiply back to check the size.
TENS_SLIP.teacher: Quotient off by ten: right ones digit, tens place slipped.
